tailoring.headline: SAP Inhouse Consultant & Senior SAP Commerce Cloud Developer | Java, Spring, Integration
tailoring.summary: Backend developer with over 5 years delivering SAP Commerce Cloud solutions for Rockwell Automation and Shell. Expert in Java, Spring, Spring Boot and REST/OCC APIs, I design and implement end-to-end e-commerce flows, integrate PIM, ERP and MDM systems, and ensure stable production operation through incident, change and release management. Skilled in techno-functional analysis, stakeholder collaboration and AI-assisted development, I drive digital sales and service processes.

APIs & Integration: PIM / ERP / MDM integration (Profisee, SAP ERP)

cover_en.subject: Application: SAP Inhouse Consultant Commerce Cloud (m/w/d)
cover_en.hook: I am excited by Pfeiffer Vacuum’s commitment to innovative vacuum solutions and its global reach. With over five years of hands-on SAP Commerce Cloud experience at Rockwell Automation and Shell, I have a proven track record of shaping digital sales and service platforms that drive growth.

bullets.label: **Integration Expertise**
bullets.text: At Rockwell Automation I designed and built PIM-to-Hybris pipelines using Profisee, DataHub and Hotfolders, and resolved integration bottlenecks with SAP ERP and MDM, delivering seamless data flow across global e-commerce channels.

bullets.label: **E-Commerce Architecture**
bullets.text: I delivered end-to-end SAP Commerce Cloud (Hybris 2211) features—from product catalog to checkout—by developing OCC REST services and customizing back-office components for Rockwell and Shell.

bullets.label: **Production & Release Management**
bullets.text: I ensured stable system operation through incident, change and release management, executing CI/CD cycles on SAP Commerce Cloud Portal (CCv2) and supporting production issues for both clients.

bullets.label: **Techno-Functional Consulting**
bullets.text: I collaborated with international business stakeholders, translated requirements into user stories and functional specs, and guided junior developers, aligning IT solutions with sales and service processes.

cover_en.logistics: Based in Karlsruhe, I hold a valid German residence and work permit, am serving notice until 15 December 2026 and can start on 16 December 2026. I look forward to discussing how I can contribute to Pfeiffer Vacuum.

cover_de.subject: Bewerbung als SAP Inhouse Consultant Commerce Cloud (m/w/d)
cover_de.hook: Mit über fünf Jahren Erfahrung in SAP Commerce Cloud bei Rockwell Automation und Shell bringe ich tiefes Know-how in der Gestaltung und Optimierung digitaler Vertriebs- und Service-Prozesse mit. Die Möglichkeit, die E-Commerce-Landschaft von Pfeiffer Vacuum weiterzuentwickeln, reizt mich besonders.

bullets.label: **Integrations-Expertise**
bullets.text: Bei Rockwell Automation habe ich PIM-zu-Hybris-Pipelines mit Profisee, DataHub und Hotfolders konzipiert und Integrationsengpässe zu SAP ERP und MDM behoben, um einen nahtlosen Datenaustausch über globale E-Commerce-Kanäle zu gewährleisten.

bullets.label: **E-Commerce-Architektur**
bullets.text: Ich habe End-to-End-SAP-Commerce-Cloud-Features (Hybris 2211) von der Produktdarstellung bis zum Checkout entwickelt, OCC-REST-Services bereitgestellt und Back-Office-Komponenten für Rockwell und Shell angepasst.

bullets.label: **Betriebs- und Release-Management**
bullets.text: Durch Incident-, Change- und Release-Management sowie CI/CD-Durchläufe im SAP-Commerce-Cloud-Portal (CCv2) habe ich einen stabilen Systembetrieb sichergestellt und Produktionsprobleme für beide Kunden unterstützt.

bullets.label: **Techno-funktionale Beratung**
bullets.text: Ich habe mit internationalen Fachbereichen zusammengearbeitet, Anforderungen in User Stories und Funktionsspezifikationen übersetzt und Junior-Entwickler angeleitet, um IT-Lösungen optimal an Vertriebs- und Serviceprozesse anzupassen.

cover_de.logistics: Ich lebe in Karlsruhe, besitze eine gültige deutsche Aufenthaltserlaubnis, befinde mich in der Kündigungsfrist bis zum 15.12.2026 und kann ab dem 16.12.2026 starten. Ich freue mich auf ein Gespräch, um meinen Beitrag zur digitalen Zukunft von Pfeiffer Vacuum zu erläutern.

tailoring.why_company: Pfeiffer Vacuum stands out for its leadership in vacuum technology across diverse industries and its commitment to sustainable innovation. I am drawn to the chance to shape the digital customer experience of a market-leading company, leveraging my SAP Commerce Cloud expertise to enhance e-commerce, service and sales processes that directly support your global growth and environmental goals.
tailoring.motivation_short: I want to apply my SAP Commerce Cloud and integration expertise to drive innovative e-commerce solutions for Pfeiffer Vacuum’s worldwide customers.
tailoring.linkedin_message: Hi, I’m Kranti Chavan, a senior SAP Commerce Cloud developer with 5+ years at Rockwell Automation and Shell. I’m eager to discuss how I can help Pfeiffer Vacuum advance its digital commerce strategy. Let’s connect!
tailoring.email_subject: Application – SAP Inhouse Consultant Commerce Cloud (m/w/d)
tailoring.email_body: Dear Hiring Team, please find attached my CV and cover letter for the SAP Inhouse Consultant Commerce Cloud position. With over five years of SAP Commerce Cloud experience at Rockwell Automation and Shell, I am ready to contribute to Pfeiffer Vacuum’s digital transformation. I look forward to the opportunity to discuss my fit for the role.
